versions.content: Communication Management shall trigger the application on reception of a notification on field value change Status: DRAFT Description: Application developers shall be able to let the platform trigger the application when a new notification on field value change has been received from another application. The platform shall not deliver the data directly, but instead provide a mechanism to read the data upon request. Rationale: It shall be possible to receive notifications on field value change sent by the server and access them in a event-based style through triggering of a processing function. Dependencies: – ▽ 27 of 36 Document ID 716: AUTOSAR_AP_RS_CommunicationManagement Requirements on Communication Management AUTOSAR AP R25-11 △ Use Case: A consumer of sensor data gets triggered on reception of a modified update rate. Supporting Material: –
